proposal.reason: Primary change is to open-source test workflow execution: daily/source-sanity GitHub Actions now generate case inputs from JSON families, add grouping/resource-policy updates (including cross-rack and 8-node handling), strengthen artifact/NAS cache validation and retry behavior, and produce/upload a performance report artifact. The large test-list/script additions and legacy CSV removals support this CI pipeline behavior rather than PCCL runtime modules.
